POINT PLEASANT, WV—As she stared over the filmmaker’s shoulder in a desperate attempt to make eye contact with any other visitor in the room, local Mothman Museum worker Haley Adkins was reportedly growing tired Wednesday of director Robert Eggers’ questions. “So, is there a way one can turn into Mothman, or is it more of a sickness one is born with?” said Eggers, the auteur behind 2024’s Nosferatu and the upcoming Werwulf, who peppered the 25-year-old, part-time museum employee incessantly with inquiries about everything from the regional cryptid’s wingspan and taxonomy to any penchant it might have for seducing beautiful, frail young women. “In your professional opinion, is this Mothman more of a Nicholas Hoult or Willem Dafoe type? I know his heyday was the ’60s, but does the historical record include any sightings of him in, say, the 1600s? Oh, and most importantly, you must tell me: Is the Mothman wet?” Eggers was later seen with a $20 bill in his hand trying to bribe the museum worker to show him the real Mothman.
